Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning withdrawals of groundwater for stock watering purposes.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to limiting withdrawals of groundwater for stockwatering purposes; amending RCW 90.44.050; and adding a new section tochapter 16.36 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 90.44.050 and 2003 c 307 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) After June 6, 1945, no withdrawal of public groundwaters of thestate shall be begun, nor shall any well or other works for suchwithdrawal be constructed, unless an application to appropriate suchwaters has been made to the department and a permit has been granted byit as herein provided: EXCEPT, HOWEVER, That any withdrawal of publicgroundwaters for stock watering purposes that is in accordance withsubsection (2) of this section, or for the watering of a lawn or of anoncommercial garden not exceeding onehalf acre in area, or for singleor group domestic uses in an amount not exceeding five thousand gallonsa day, or as provided in RCW 90.44.052, or for an industrial purpose inan amount not exceeding five thousand gallons a day, is and shall beexempt from the provisions of this section, but, to the extent that itis regularly used beneficially, shall be entitled to a right equal to p. 1 HB 2599that established by a permit issued under the provisions of thischapter: PROVIDED, HOWEVER, That the department from time to time mayrequire the person or agency making any such small withdrawal tofurnish information as to the means for and the quantity of thatwithdrawal: PROVIDED, FURTHER, That at the option of the party makingwithdrawals of groundwaters of the state not exceeding five thousandgallons per day, applications under this section or declarations underRCW 90.44.090 may be filed and permits and certificates obtained in thesame manner and under the same requirements as is in this chapterprovided in the case of withdrawals in excess of five thousand gallonsa day. (2)(a) After the effective date of this section, withdrawal ofpublic groundwaters for stock watering purposes must be metered and maynot exceed five thousand gallons per day, except those withdrawalsauthorized in (b) of this subsection. (b) The withdrawer of public groundwaters that are put tobeneficial use for stock watering purposes prior to the effective dateof this section may continue to withdraw public groundwaters for stockwatering purposes in an amount not exceeding five thousand gallons perday or their total per livestock water limit as determined by theWashington state department of agriculture in section 2 of this act forthe highest daily number of livestock present in 2009 on the parcelwhere the permit exempt well used for stock watering is located.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 16.36 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department must determine by rule the average daily water useof individual livestock in Washington. The estimate of water use perindividual livestock must include all reasonable uses of water neededfor domestic farm animals for drinking and for maintenance of livestockhealth and welfare.
